name: Kingpin
summary: Wilson Fisk is a crime boss who debuted in Spider-Man’s comic. He later became a defining Daredevil antagonist as well. Both relationships are real. He is not only a Spider-Man villain.
relation: Debuted as a Spider-Man crime lord. Also central to Daredevil.
creators: Stan Lee and John Romita Sr.
powers: Enormous strength and a criminal empire. He is not superpowered in his original stories.
origin: A seemingly genteel businessman who runs New York crime.
